title: MADEINWARIO

emulator.name: mGBA
emulator.render: CPU software framebuffer, headless C API
emulator.sampling: 650 frames from a pre-selection snapshot per ROM table entry; captures at +250, +370 and +500. Scripted neutral, D-pad, A and B inputs.

observed: One short imperative instruction before each microgame
A small countdown fuse outside the main interaction
One main action or a few directional inputs per short challenge
Immediate character reactions and a persistent life/score intermission
Speed-up announcements visible after the third and sixth rounds in the opening stage
Visually distinct scenes with a clear interactive object
scope: All 250 ROM table entries identified and sampled, covering 213 named implementations plus duplicates and internal variants. Opening transitions observed separately. Initial-difficulty scene and input analysis; not an all-difficulty completion run.

adaptation.controls: D-pad / virtual stick + A and B only
adaptation.practice: Unaccelerated; at least 15 seconds before the outer timeout

metadataSource.crossRegionValidation: All 250 internal labels and entry order verified against the uploaded Japanese ROM; US addresses were not reused.
